fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Game working memory and stack. Wiped to zero at every power-on, so nothing here survives a power cycle; not part of the save
fields.evidence: code d000:0047 clears 0x6fff bytes at power-on; diffs change every step

fields.name: padding
fields.meaning: Byte just below the save block; never written by the save code, always 00
fields.evidence: code d000:6713 never touches it; diffs always 00

fields.name: start marker
fields.meaning: Start-of-block marker, always 02; the loader rejects the save if it is not 02
fields.evidence: code d000:6713 writes, d000:6854 checks (error 1); diffs

fields.name: data length
fields.meaning: Length of the data part, always 0x035a (858 bytes)
fields.evidence: code d000:6713 writes it, d000:6854 uses it to find the end marker; diffs

fields.name: clock ticks
fields.meaning: Sub-second part of the in-game clock, 0-74 (one game second is 75 ticks)
fields.evidence: code f000:1bb1 adds the speed and wraps at 75; diffs

fields.name: clock seconds
fields.meaning: In-game clock seconds, 0-59
fields.evidence: code f000:1bc5; diffs

fields.name: clock minutes
fields.meaning: In-game clock minutes, 0-59; the verified save holds 28 and the game shows 12:29 after loading
fields.evidence: code f000:1be2; diffs; clock shown on screen

fields.name: clock hours
fields.meaning: In-game clock hours, 0-23; a new game starts at 12
fields.evidence: code f000:1bf2 wraps at 24, d000:4bd1 sets 12; diff 12 -> 13 at the hour rollover

fields.name: clock speed
fields.meaning: Ticks added per clock update (new game: 30); controls how fast the in-game clock runs
fields.evidence: code d000:4c38 sets 30, f000:1bb1 adds it; diffs always 30

fields.name: battle counter A
fields.meaning: Matches played counted when the result flag is clear (one half of the win/loss record; which half is open)
fields.evidence: code e000:c247 (+1), f000:5f1e shows A+B on a record screen; diffs always 0, no matches played

fields.name: battle counter B
fields.meaning: Matches played counted when the result flag is set (the other half of the win/loss record)
fields.evidence: code e000:c23b (+1), f000:5f1e; diffs always 0

fields.name: hours played
fields.meaning: In-game hours elapsed; raised each time the clock rolls to a new hour
fields.evidence: code f000:1c02 (+1 at hour rollover), shown by f000:5f1e; diff 0 -> 1 at 13:00

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Cleared at a new game; no other use found
fields.evidence: code d000:4c2e only; diffs always 0

fields.name: state flags
fields.meaning: Bit flags tested in several places (value 0x1f checked, bits 0x08/0x10)
fields.evidence: code d000:4c33 clears, d000:b86f tests; diffs always 0

fields.name: list A
fields.meaning: Five one-byte ids, 0xFF = empty; refilled as a group from working memory
fields.evidence: code d000:4c5e fills ff, e000:0378 stores 5 bytes; diffs all ff

fields.name: list A levels
fields.meaning: Five one-byte levels paired with list A (0-4); together with the menu position they select the reward-table row for money and items won
fields.evidence: code d000:4c71 clears, e000:c820 builds the row index, e000:c96a pays out; diffs all 0

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money total, capped at 60000; a battle reward adds (table value + random) x 10
fields.evidence: code e000:c9c7 adds the reward and caps at 60000; diffs always 0

fields.name: item list
fields.meaning: Thirty one-byte item ids, 0xFF = empty slot; using an item consumes it back to 0xFF
fields.evidence: code d000:4c4b fills ff, e000:c73c tests ff, e000:c754 consumes; diffs all ff

fields.name: records C
fields.meaning: Ten records of 25 bytes: bytes 0-9 are 0xFF, bytes 10-18 are never written (zero only because power-on wipes memory), bytes 19-24 are 0xFF; meaning unknown
fields.evidence: code d000:4c80 writes exactly this pattern; diffs unchanged in every save

fields.name: collection flags
fields.meaning: Flags 0-79 as single bits, set with OR when things happen in the game; a record screen counts how many are set
fields.evidence: code f000:4439 sets bit n, f000:5f1e counts them; diffs always 0

fields.name: flags 80-81 plus constant
fields.meaning: Bits 0-1 are flags 80-81 (same collection as above); bits 2-7 are constant 1, so a new game shows 0xFC
fields.evidence: code f000:4439 can set bits 0-1, f000:5f1e counts 2 bits here, d000:4cf6 sets fc; diffs always fc

fields.name: record state +00
fields.meaning: Mode word, one per creature record (8 records, 0x43 bytes apart at 7145, 7188, 71cb, 720e, 7251, 7294, 72d7, 731a). 0 after new-game creation; the create routine defaults it to 8 and other creation modes set 0x6c
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged (no gameplay event touched the records)

fields.name: record +02 unknown
fields.meaning: Four zero words at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +0A unknown
fields.meaning: Word set to 1 at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +0C unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +0D species
fields.meaning: Creature kind number, used to index the 27-byte rows of the ROM species table (all 0 = starting kind), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4 stores the kind argument then reads that table row; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +0E name
fields.meaning: Up to 8 id bytes copied from species-table row bytes +3 onwards (0xFF in the table becomes 0; copying stops before the 2D 38 end mark), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:49df loop; new-game kind 0 gives 4d 1a then zeros; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +16 marker
fields.meaning: Always 0xFF after creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:4a6e; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +17 unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +18 table value
fields.meaning: Copied from species-table row byte +2 at creation (5 for the starting kind), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:457f; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +19 unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +1B table value
fields.meaning: Copied from species-table row byte +0xF at creation (5 for the starting kind), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:45d2; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +1C birth hour
fields.meaning: Clock hour when the record was created (12 in a new game), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:45f9 copies the clock hours; diff 0c

fields.name: record +1D birth minute
fields.meaning: Clock minute when the record was created, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:460f copies the clock minutes; diff 00

fields.name: record +1E unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation; the third byte is later read back and clamped to 99, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4 writes, d000:b885 reads byte +20; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +21 table value
fields.meaning: Copied from species-table row byte +0x10 at creation (1 for the starting kind), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:4664; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +22 stat 1
fields.meaning: Species-table row byte +0x11 plus a random 0-15, stored three times (current, maximum and base of one stat; starting kind: 24 + random), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:468e with RNG d000:0376; diff differs per record

fields.name: record +25 unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +26 timer
fields.meaning: Set to 25 for kinds whose kind-class test returns 0, else 180, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:4710 with test f000:452f; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +27 unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +2C constant
fields.meaning: Set to 59 at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:47ba; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +2D stat 2
fields.meaning: Species-table row byte +0x15 plus a random 0-15 (starting kind: 4 + random), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:47d1 with RNG d000:0376; diff differs per record

fields.name: record +2F unknown
fields.meaning: Zero at creation (other creation modes set the first two to 0x14), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +32 unknown
fields.meaning: Three zero words at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +38 table value
fields.meaning: Copied from species-table row byte +0x16 at creation (0x14 for the starting kind), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:4881; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +39 kind list
fields.meaning: Kind number again followed by five 0xFF (empty) entries, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:48a5; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +3F group
fields.meaning: Group from the kind (kind/14 for kinds below 0x38, 4 for 0x38-0x4b, else 5), per record
fields.evidence: code d000:4903; diffs unchanged

fields.name: record +40 unknown
fields.meaning: Word and byte, zero at creation, per record
fields.evidence: code d000:44a4; diffs unchanged

fields.name: end marker
fields.meaning: End-of-block marker, always 03; the loader rejects the save if it is not 03
fields.evidence: code d000:6713 writes, d000:6854 checks (error 2); diffs

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (reflected 0x1021, start 0) over the length field, the data and the end marker (7001-735d), stored low byte first
fields.evidence: code d000:051e table CRC; recomputed equal on every natural save with a save block

fields.name: hourly backup copy
fields.meaning: Second copy written by the hourly save with the same layout, starting at 735a, so its first 6 bytes overlap the main copy and are destroyed by the next main save. The loader never reads it (it checks the main copy twice), so it has no effect
fields.evidence: code f000:1c0c writes copy 2, d000:67ea loads from 7000 only; diff written in full at the 13:00 rollover

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written by the game
fields.evidence: diffs all zero

values.value: same layout as the main block; never loaded (loader only checks the main copy), and its first 6 bytes are destroyed by every main-copy save
this game keeps its save in cartridge SRAM only; the internal EEPROM is never written

args.value: no save block (start marker is not 02)
